package.description: USB kill-switch — shuts down the PC when a mapped USB device is removed

en-US.description: USB kill-switch — shuts down the PC when a mapped USB device is removed
en-US.longDescription: Map any USB device as a kill-switch key. When it is removed while the sentinel is armed, the machine shuts down immediately. Designed to make recovering encrypted drive keys as hard as possible if someone physically seizes your machine.
en-US.name: xxUSBSentinel
